records.subject: Household Income
records.groupTitle: Average Annual Government Transfers Per Household Member Among Resident Households
records.title: Average Annual Government Transfers Per Household Member Among Resident Households by Transfer Type, 2015 – 2025
records.footnote: Note: As more administrative data on transfers become available, the coverage for Government transfers has been expanded over the years to include more type of transfers. Refer to the glossary (https://www.singstat.gov.sg/files/38edc794-eaa0-4582-9c6a-3d152e18bdd1.pdf) of the latest Key Household Income Trends paper for the Government transfers that are included. Data for the latest year are preliminary.

column1.footnote: 1/ Regular government contributions refer to recurring cash disbursements, top-ups or rebates (e.g. Workfare Income Supplement, GST Vouchers, Pioneer Generation MediSave Top-ups).
2/ Ad-hoc government contributions refer to one-off disbursements (e.g. CDC Vouchers, Post-Secondary Education Account Top-ups, One-off Retirement Savings Bonus under the Majulah Package).
3/ Transfers in-kind refer to value of in-kind benefits through subsidised services or goods (e.g. Education Subsidies, Centre-Based Infant and Child Care Subsidies).
